title: Launchpad microflow: concise capacity estimator, autoscale heuristics, and SLA snapshot panels
creator: Marina Lopez
description: Design a compact, single-screen Launchpad microflow that helps new Dedicated customers select initial capacity, configure autoscale heuristics, and understand SLA tradeoffs. Goal: reduce time-to-first-request from signup to serving to under 10 minutes while lowering cognitive load vs the current multi-step wizard. Deliver high-fidelity frames, annotated component tokens, and a set of exported screenshots for docs and release notes.
deliverables: Figma file with 5 responsive frames (desktop/tablet/phone) including interactive variants: estimator, autoscale slider, SLA snapshot, fallback state, and confirmation
Annotated component spec (token names, spacing, color token values, microcopy strings, accessibility contrast notes)
3 exported PNG screenshots sized for docs (1200x700, 800x450, 640x360) and 1 animated GIF for product landing
Microcopy library for each control (tooltips, helper text, inline validation, SLO tooltip content)
Handoff package: slice assets + redlines + developer notes uploaded to Drive + link in PR
acceptance_criteria: Estimator frame shows predicted peak QPS, recommended GPU count, and monthly cost range (low/median/high) with supporting rationale
Autoscale slider has three suggested heuristics (conservative, balanced, aggressive) and an advanced link for custom rules
SLA snapshot card displays expected p99 latency, target uptime, and fallback policy text; each metric has an info tooltip and link to the SLA docs
All frames annotated with component token names and spacing; exported assets meet resolution and naming conventions for product docs
Design reviewed and approved by PM and Eng (design review meeting notes attached)
